# Mount Disk Image

macOS 12 +

## Notes

Mount's the given disk image.

## Syntax

~~~~text
mountDiskImage(diskImage: <#Variable (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
mountDiskImage(diskImage: Ask)
~~~~
